assumption: The Stage I canonical loss-CVaR model CT1--CT10 is the retained baseline
verification_or_falsification: Validate links to theory/repaired/canonical_theorem_set.md and teacher baseline hashes
failure_effect: No Stage II result may be interpreted independently of the repaired sign and feasible-set conventions

assumption: Every admissible primitive tuple explicitly specifies cardinal margins, profit law, feasible set, risk limit and optimizer selection
verification_or_falsification: Schema and mapping validation; no implicit primitive class
failure_effect: Allocation identification claims are undefined

assumption: The optimizer-selection rule is deterministic, documented and held fixed across a selected counterfactual comparison
verification_or_falsification: Replay identical optimal faces and verify identical selected vertices
failure_effect: Selected attribution is not reproducible; report only optimal-face ranges

assumption: Suitability ties and the acreage tolerance tau_x are declared before classification
verification_or_falsification: Tie-class and tolerance fields in every downstream design
failure_effect: Strict ranking or reversal labels are not well defined

assumption: When profit-based rank preservation is invoked, suitability and expected margin induce the same strict top-rank ordering; numerical equality is not assumed
verification_or_falsification: Compare order only and record monetary units separately
failure_effect: The corollary cannot connect suitability to the objective

assumption: Every reversed feasible point covered by the exchange certificate admits a positive pairwise transfer e_i-e_j inside the operational feasible set
verification_or_falsification: Analytic tangent/finite-step check for each covered point
failure_effect: The exchange proof does not exclude boundary-forced reversal

assumption: The exchange step is risk-feasible by direct evaluation, strict slack plus continuity, or a strictly negative CVaR directional derivative at a binding boundary
verification_or_falsification: Direct finite-step CVaR check is primary; zero derivative is insufficient
failure_effect: No risk-feasible improvement certificate exists

assumption: The restricted winner-take-all case has only nonnegativity and a land inequality, A>0, a unique positive top margin and a redundant CVaR constraint
verification_or_falsification: Solve the analytic simplex case and test every excluded assumption
failure_effect: The winner-take-all conclusion is not available

assumption: The canonical risk-feasible set is nonempty at every risk limit or dependence state being compared
verification_or_falsification: Phase-I feasibility LP at every endpoint and refinement point
failure_effect: Value/allocation comparisons must report infeasibility rather than extrapolate

assumption: Convex KKT qualification holds or the finite-scenario LP is feasible and bounded
verification_or_falsification: Primal-dual residual and strong-duality certificate
failure_effect: Pressure terms are not certified optimality quantities

assumption: One atom-safe CVaR subgradient or normalized scenario-dual tail-weight vector is recorded
verification_or_falsification: Tail weights are nonnegative, capped and sum to one when the risk dual is positive
failure_effect: A unique marginal-CVaR derivative must not be reported

assumption: All pressure terms use objective currency per acre after a common real-dollar base and declared acreage unit
verification_or_falsification: Dimension audit and residual reconstruction
failure_effect: Cross-term magnitudes cannot be compared

assumption: Every counterfactual block has a coherent fallback value defined before results and uses common exogenous inputs where comparison requires them
verification_or_falsification: Freeze block table, scenarios, tolerances and fallback parameters
failure_effect: Block differences confound mechanism and design changes

assumption: Symmetric attribution evaluates all 2^K block subsets with the same selection rule
verification_or_falsification: Completeness and efficiency tests over the subset lattice
failure_effect: Use declared path attribution plus order sensitivity instead

assumption: True-law and assumed-law comparisons hold margins, action set, risk convention and evaluation draws fixed
verification_or_falsification: Paired true-law evaluation and parameter registry
failure_effect: Regret or pseudo-diversification cannot be attributed to dependence misspecification

assumption: Signal timing is signal observation then acreage policy choice then profit realization; uninformed constant policies are feasible informed policies
verification_or_falsification: Policy-space inclusion and timing diagram
failure_effect: Nonnegative operational information value is not guaranteed by the stated model

assumption: A more informative experiment can reproduce the less informative signal through a registered garbling, allowing independent randomization
verification_or_falsification: Verify stochastic garbling matrix and induced joint law
failure_effect: Precision labels alone do not order information value

assumption: Flexibility expands the operational action sets X(phi) by verified nesting
verification_or_falsification: Set-inclusion validator for every adjacent flexibility level
failure_effect: Even weak informed or uninformed value monotonicity is not established

assumption: For conditional complementarity, the policy/action domain is a lattice, feasible correspondences are nonempty compact sublattices increasing in strong set order, and the policy payoff is jointly supermodular
verification_or_falsification: Prove each lattice closure and four-point supermodularity inequality
failure_effect: Strict/general complementarity remains a numerical hypothesis or is rejected

assumption: Any claim of strict complementarity additionally has a strict cross-difference on the declared parameter range
verification_or_falsification: Simultaneous lower confidence bound for every preregistered cross-difference is above zero
failure_effect: Only weak complementarity or a null/substitution result is admissible

assumption: A full-land-use claim has a feasible positive-mean expansion that preserves every operational and CVaR constraint
verification_or_falsification: Construct and evaluate the expansion direction
failure_effect: Idle land may be optimal

assumption: Empirical variables are timestamped before acreage choice and tagged observed, proxy, model-derived or unavailable
verification_or_falsification: Registry and design audit
failure_effect: Mechanism validation or causal language is inadmissible
